why_ai: Physical storage and handling of goods persists; robotics trims labour but shippers still pay 3PLs.
why_clarity: Orders ship accurately and on time or not, across thousands of repeat picks.
why_digital: Physical goods stored and moved by hand under a WMS; contracts tendered nationally.

why_ai: Rate-card billing is fully deterministic once configured, a direct automation target.
why_clarity: Each charge follows the client's rate card exactly and reconciles to WMS activity.
why_digital: WMS activity in, invoices and reconciliations out, all digital.

why_ai: Risk-bearing underwriting against organised cargo theft, with adjusters and risk engineers in the field.
why_clarity: Rating rules exist, but theft patterns shift and losses reveal mispricing slowly.
why_digital: Claims and facility data analysed on screens, with site risk surveys; placed through brokers.

why_ai: Each-picking and packing remain mostly human hands in 2031, though robots assist travel.
why_clarity: Every order is picked, packed and shipped correctly or not, instantly verifiable.
why_digital: Orders arrive online but goods are picked and shipped physically; brands choose 3PLs remotely.

why_ai: Manual time studies are being replaced by computer vision and WMS task data.
why_clarity: Time study methods are codified and standards are checked against measured task times.
why_digital: Observed floor work feeds standards built on screens and delivered as documents.

why_ai: Physical frozen and refrigerated handling under FSMA traceability rules with accountable food safety staff.
why_clarity: Temperature zones, FIFO and lot traceability give clear pass or fail.
why_digital: Physical food stored and handled in cold rooms, contracted with regional shippers.

why_ai: Auditing and coding invoices against contracts is routine rule work that software automates.
why_clarity: Each invoice line matches contract terms or is corrected, with GL coding rules.
why_digital: Invoices in, payments, coding and spend analytics out, all digital.

why_ai: Contributed transactional rates in a market with no exchange form a moat AI cannot recreate.
why_clarity: Weekly lane benchmarks are computed the same way and checked against settled rates.
why_digital: Rate submissions in, benchmarks out, sold online.

why_ai: AI translation handles instructions, but on-floor supervision and training need trusted bilingual people.
why_clarity: Training completion, safety and error rates are measurable per worker and shift.
why_digital: Workers trained and supervised in person on the warehouse floor.

why_ai: Decades of direct-survey property research in a market with no public record is a durable moat.
why_clarity: Quarterly availability and rent benchmarks follow a fixed method by submarket.
why_digital: Survey calls and records in, benchmarks and analytics out, sold online.

why_ai: Association standing carries the annual report; survey analysis itself is routine.
why_clarity: Annual cost and benchmark reports recur with a fixed method.
why_digital: Surveys and reports online, funded through membership and events.

why_ai: Shippers trust neutral consultants to run tenders; network optimisation itself is software.
why_clarity: Optimisation models are codified, but network savings are realised years after the study.
why_digital: Client data modelled on screens, with facility visits and tender meetings.

why_ai: Line-item audit automates; cross-client rate visibility supports human contract negotiation.
why_clarity: Each invoice line is checked against contract terms and refunds are confirmed.
why_digital: Carrier invoices in, refunds and benchmarks out, entirely digital.

why_ai: Vessel and container tracking is data integration and prediction that software performs.
why_clarity: Arrival predictions are checked objectively when each vessel arrives.
why_digital: Position feeds and filings in, visibility products out online.

why_ai: Unloading and counting stay physical, but counting, ASN matching and location assignment automate.
why_clarity: Counts match the ASN or not, and each unit goes to an assigned location.
why_digital: Physical goods unloaded at the dock, with ASN data and scans alongside.

why_ai: Short-term physical storage and fulfilment still need space and hands on site.
why_clarity: Goods stored and shipped correctly within a window, though each engagement differs.
why_digital: Physical storage with paper pick tickets, often booked through online capacity marketplaces.

why_ai: Physical overflow storage runs on informal local relationships between manufacturer and warehouse.
why_clarity: Inventory is stored and released correctly, but needs are irregular.
why_digital: Physical goods stored nearby, coordinated by email and phone.

why_ai: Variable kits of four to eight items are assembled by hand, which robots handle poorly.
why_clarity: Each box contains the right variant and inserts or not, scan-verifiable.
why_digital: Subscriber data online, but boxes are physically assembled and shipped.

why_ai: Multi-tier graphs from filings and shipping records are assembly work AI accelerates.
why_clarity: Mapping methods are defined, but rare disruptions are the only test of accuracy.
why_digital: Filings and shipping records in, risk maps and alerts out online.

why_ai: Margin and productivity analytics automate; acquisition screening keeps some consequential judgement.
why_clarity: Bid-versus-realised margins are measurable across hundreds of contracts.
why_digital: Cost and productivity data across facilities analysed on screens.

why_ai: Sizing bespoke automation for a facility is engineering judgement tied to physical commissioning.
why_clarity: Installed systems either meet the simulated throughput or miss it.
why_digital: Simulations built on screens, then tuned at the installed site.

why_ai: Slotting, labour and wave logic are software that AI-native platforms can rebuild.
why_clarity: Optimisation outputs are checked daily against pick and travel records.
why_digital: Execution data in, optimisation logic out, delivered as software.
